URL = "http://api.aihub.woa.com/v1/messages"
HEADERS = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Authorization": (
        f"Bearer {API_KEY}?provider={PROVIDER}"
        f"&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}"
    ),
    # "Authorization": (
    #     f"Bearer {API_KEY}?provider={PROVIDER}"
    #     f"&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}&timeout=3600"
    # ),
    "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
}

body = {
    "model": "claude-opus-5-5",
    "max_tokens": 4096,
    "stream": False,
    "messages": [
        {"role": "user", "content": "Reply with exactly OK."},
    ],
    # "system": [{
    #     "type": "text",
    #     "text": "You are a concise assistant.",
    #     "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"},
    # }],
    # "tools": [{
    #     "name": "get_weather",
    #     "description": "Get weather for a city",
    #     "input_schema": {
    #         "type": "object",
    #         "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
    #         "required": ["city"],
    #     },
    # }],
    # "tool_choice": {"type": "auto"},
}
# conflux-cursor 不支持 Vision（图片/PDF 块返回 400），请省略。

r = requests.post(
    URL, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=120, stream=body["stream"]
)
r.raise_for_status()

if body["stream"]:
    for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if not line or not line.startswith("data:"):
            continue
        data = line[5:].lstrip()
        if not data or data == "[DONE]":
            continue
        event = json.loads(data)
        if event.get("type") == "content_block_delta":
            delta = event.get("delta", {})
            print(delta.get("text", ""), end="", flush=True)
    print()
else:
    d = r.json()
    print(json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

cache_guidance.affinity_rule: 同一对话上下文复用同一个值，不同对话必须用不同值。该值只影响平台选号：相同值的请求会被路由到同一个上游账号。
cache_guidance.note: 两者需配合使用：cache_task_id 保证请求落到同一账号，prompt 缓存参数才可能在厂商侧命中；只设其一均无缓存收益。affinity_wire_format 为空表示平台尚未对外明确传参方式，请勿自行猜测。
